requiredEnv.TERRARIUM_MODEL: Nonsecret terrarium/model spec for `opencode run --model`; the runner refuses every other provider.
requiredEnv.OPENCODE_CONFIG: Path to the baked credentialless provider config.

optionalEnv.TERRARIUM_AGENT: Optional agent name passed via `opencode run --agent`.

notes: The runner treats task/contract text as data only. Task/contract paths are also baked into src/cloud/sandbox-backend.js.
